notes.title: September 26, THE RELEASE DATE!!!
notes.notes:
Hi, 

We are proud to announce the official release date of The Works of Mercy. It will be September 26th. Thank you for your patience. 

Pentacle

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

It is our deepest regret to inform you that the release date of The Works of Mercy, which was originally scheduled on the 7th of June, has been postponed. The extra time will be used to polish the quality of the game to the highest standards. We would like to sincerely apologize to all those who have been awaiting the release of the game.  We sincerely thank you for your patience and hope that when you get to play the game, you will agree the wait will have been worth it. The new release date to be announced soon. 

Best regards,
PENTACLE
